comment: No source is published for MM_Tools. SMExpL multiplies each of its input voltages by 0.1 before handing them to SMMix, while SMMix's own IN 1 to IN 8 are merged unscaled. Nothing on the panel or in the README says so, and it looks like an oversight rather than a design, but it is what the code does: IN 9 to IN 16 land on the POLY output 20dB down.
